sources.use: Authoritative access-site anchor shared by Guyandotte Water Trail Trips 9 and 10; exact wetted-edge point is not claimed.

sources.title: WVDNR District 5 Fishing Guide
sources.provider: West Virginia Division of Natural Resources
sources.observation: The Man: Logan row lists the Guyandotte River access with coordinate 37.7441, -81.8979, about 0.55 mile west of the current live GIS point at the same latitude.
sources.use: Primary-source conflict documented; do not merge the PDF coordinate with the live feature without field or newer official confirmation.

sources.title: Guyandotte River Water Trail Map 3
sources.observation: The route dossier names Trips 9 and 10 as Wylo-to-Man (5 miles) and Man-to-Earling (3.8 miles). It describes the Man access as a gravel pull-off or a concrete boat ramp at a public access sign; the PDF itself was not used to independently georeference the pin in this session.
sources.use: Confirms the shared access's route identity, while its ramp description conflicts with current WVDNR GIS's Carry Down classification.

sources.title: Google Maps satellite imagery at WVDNR Man point
sources.observation: The state GIS point falls at the river-side access corridor near the highway and visible road/clearing approach. Imagery supports site placement but does not resolve ramp material, a current sign, or a survey-grade water-entry toe.
sources.use: Visual corroboration only; imagery is not public-access authorization.
